collection.title: BMW 5 Series Grand Turismo 2009 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 5 Series Gran Tourismo 2009 to 2017 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
